content.comment_body: I'm working with a [product_name] module that sends text messages from our system. The [product_name] basis module assigns values for each unit in a VM word: if the value is 0, no message is sent; if it's greater than zero, the value indicates which message should be sent. This is my input setup. I wanted to use a placeholder in the SMS text, hoping it would substitute with the message text corresponding to the value, but instead it only sends the numeric value (see attached screenshot). Here are my monitoring settings. Any advice would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is struggling with the SMS functionality of a [product_name] module, which currently only transmits numeric VM word values instead of replacing placeholders with detailed message texts.
